machine: Intel Celeron N4000 @ 1.10GHz, 2 cores, linux/amd64, go 1.24
method: go test -bench -benchmem -count=3 (median); CLI wall-clock over typo-injected werther.txt corpus (and->adn, the->teh, you->yu, with->wth)

BenchmarkSuggest.note: 5 repeated typos; memo cache turns BK re-search per occurrence into map hit

BenchmarkSuggestDistinct.note: 100 unique near-miss typos; ASCII Levenshtein fast path + pooled DP rows

BenchmarkOSA.note: unchanged code path; sanity check no regression

BenchmarkRankSuggestions.note: unchanged code path; sanity check no regression

BenchmarkScanForTypos.note: 100x repeated typo paragraph; memoization amortizes repeated typos

scan_275kb_markdown.note: baseline extrapolated >8min from 50KB linear rate; not run to completion
